name: Nocturne
tagline: Option selling on MCX crude oil, natural gas and gold
summary: Nocturne sells one option at a time on each of three MCX commodities: crude oil, natural gas and gold mini. It sells a put when Firefly's rules turn up and a call when they turn down, and holds through the evening session and overnight, from a few hours to a few days, until the trend reverses or a target or stop is hit.
risk: Every position is a short option with no hedge, so the loss on a trade is not capped, and commodity prices can gap between sessions. Selling options needs exchange margin far above the premium received. Results are before brokerage, taxes and slippage; commodity options trade with wide spreads, so real fills would be worse than the prices used here.
